# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On June 27, 2024, Gladstone Business Loan, LLC entered into Amendment No. 7 to their Sixth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement originally dated May 13, 2021.
- Gladstone Business Loan, LLC serves as the Borrower, with Gladstone Management Corporation as Servicer. KeyBank National Association acts as both Administrative Agent and Swingline Lender.
- The primary purpose of this amendment is to add First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company as a new Lender, Lender Group, and Managing Agent to the existing credit facility.
- The amendment updates the commitment definitions to reflect the current lender syndicate, which includes KeyBank ($70.4M), ING ($38.4M), Huntington ($21.3M), FNBP ($8.5M), Webster Bank ($40M), First Foundation ($25M), First Financial ($20M), WSFS ($10M), GBC ($10M), and the newly added FCB ($25M).
- Gladstone Business Loan appears to be a business development company or similar lending entity, given the structure with a separate servicer and the nature of the credit facility.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• Strong and diversified lender syndicate including established financial institutions (KeyBank, ING, Huntington, Webster Bank, Bank of America affiliates)
• Expansion of lender base demonstrates continued market confidence and demand for the credit facility
• No Early Termination Events or Unmatured Termination Events reported as of the amendment date
• Professional management structure with dedicated servicer (Gladstone Management Corporation)

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• Limited visibility into underlying portfolio performance, financial covenants, or credit metrics from this amendment document alone
• Amendment documents typically provide minimal information on current financial health or operating performance
• Borrower structure as a lending entity creates inherent credit risk exposure to underlying borrower portfolio
